data.title: Seller Impersonation Pattern — Property Sale Initiated by Non-Resident Owner of Vacant/Unencumbered Property With Recent Contact Info Changes
data.description: Detects the characteristic seller impersonation pattern in real estate title fraud: a property sale or title transfer is initiated on a vacant, unencumbered property where the owner is non-resident (mailing address differs from property address) and the owner's contact information has been recently changed. FBI data shows $16.6B in total real estate fraud losses (2024), with seller impersonation of vacant property owners as the fastest-growing subcategory. Fraudsters target vacant, mortgage-free properties because there is no occupant to notice and no lender monitoring the title. A risk score is computed from multiple indicators: non-resident owner, vacant property, unencumbered, recent contact changes, and below-market listing price.

detection.condition: selection AND (filter_vacant_or_nonresident OR owner_address_mismatch) AND filter_unencumbered AND filter_recent_contact_change

enrichment_required.source: Days since last contact information change in county records or title company CRM
Boolean flag indicating owner mailing address differs from property address
AVM (Automated Valuation Model) or recent comparable sales data

queries.cql:
// CQL for Seller Impersonation Pattern — DL-0186
// Detects property sale by non-resident owner of vacant/unencumbered property
PropertyTransactions
| transaction_type = "sale_listing" OR transaction_type = "title_transfer" OR transaction_type = "deed_recording"
| non_resident := if(property_address != owner_mailing_address, 1, 0)
| unencumbered := if(mortgage_balance <= 0 OR mortgage_balance = null, 1, 0)
| vacant := if(occupancy_status = "vacant", 1, 0)
| recent_contact_change := if(owner_contact_updated_days < 90, 1, 0)
| below_market := if(listing_price < assessed_value * 0.85, 1, 0)
| risk_score := non_resident + unencumbered + vacant + recent_contact_change + below_market
| risk_score >= 3
| risk_level := if(risk_score >= 5, "critical", if(risk_score >= 4, "high", "medium"))
| listing_to_market_ratio := round(listing_price / assessed_value * 100, 1)
| sort(risk_score, order=desc)

  (transaction_type="sale_listing" OR transaction_type="title_transfer"

| eval below_market = if(listing_price < assessed_value * 0.85, 1, 0)

| where risk_score >= 3
| eval risk_level = case(
    risk_score >= 5, "critical",
    risk_score >= 4, "high",
    risk_score >= 3, "medium")

        listing_to_market_ratio, occupancy_status, mortgage_balance,

        recent_contact_change, below_market, risk_score, risk_level
| sort - risk_score
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Seller Impersonation Pattern Detection
-- Property sale by non-resident owner of vacant/unencumbered property
SELECT
  p.property_id,
  p.property_address,
  p.property_type,
  p.assessed_value,
  p.occupancy_status,
  p.mortgage_balance,
  o.owner_name,
  o.owner_mailing_address,
  DATEDIFF(DAY, o.contact_last_updated, CURRENT_DATE) AS contact_updated_days_ago,
  t.transaction_type,
  t.listing_price,
  t.listing_date,
  ROUND(t.listing_price * 100.0 / NULLIF(p.assessed_value, 0), 1) AS listing_to_market_pct,
  (CASE WHEN p.property_address != o.owner_mailing_address THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.mortgage_balance <= 0 OR p.mortgage_balance IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.occupancy_status = 'vacant' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN o.contact_last_updated >= DATEADD(DAY, -90, CURRENT_DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN t.listing_price < p.assessed_value * 0.85 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS risk_score
FROM properties p
JOIN property_owners o ON p.property_id = o.property_id
JOIN property_transactions t ON p.property_id = t.property_id
WHERE t.transaction_type IN ('sale_listing', 'title_transfer', 'deed_recording')
  AND t.listing_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, CURRENT_DATE)
  AND (p.occupancy_status = 'vacant' OR p.property_address != o.owner_mailing_address)
  AND (p.mortgage_balance <= 0 OR p.mortgage_balance IS NULL)
HAVING risk_score >= 3
ORDER BY risk_score DESC, t.listing_date DESC

references: First American, Title Fraud: Emerging Threats and Prevention Strategies
ALTA, Best Practices for Title Insurance and Settlement
falsepositives: Legitimate sales of investment properties by non-resident owners
Estate sales of inherited vacant properties
Property owners with recently updated contact info due to relocation
Below-market listings for quick sales (divorce, financial hardship)
Vacant lot sales by developers or investors
